commits.subject: m13: selectors, ci target, slim CI workflow + PR template; fct_sessions.is_bounce

lines: +## What does this pull request change?
+<!-- One or two sentences. Which models, tests, sources? -->
+<!-- Link to the ticket or explain the business need. -->
+- [ ] New or changed models have a description and tests (primary key at least)
+- [ ] Public models: contract updated; a breaking change gets a NEW VERSION
+- [ ] Row counts / key numbers compared before and after (paste them below)
+<!-- e.g. dbt show output, row counts, screenshots of the docs lineage -->
+# Slim CI for ShopFlow (dbt Core + DuckDB).
+# On every pull request to main: build and test ONLY the modified models and their
+# children, and read every other model from production (--defer --state).
+      - name: Check out the pull request
+      - name: Install dbt Core and the DuckDB adapter
+      - name: Install packages and parse the project (YAML and Jinja errors stop here)
+      # With a cloud warehouse, the CI target would connect with secrets and the manifest
+      # would come from the last production job. With DuckDB, we download a copy of the
+      # production database and of its manifest, published as the "ci-state" release.
+      - name: Dry run of the modified models (--empty reads no rows)
+      - name: Build and test the modified models and their children
Always run dbt from this folder (the database path is relative).
+## Production, state and slim CI (milestone m13)
+dbt build --target prod --selector nightly          # production run (no unit tests)
+dbt ls -s state:modified+ --state prod-artifacts     # what changed in my branch?
+The GitHub Actions workflow `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs the same slim CI on every
+pull request. It downloads the production state from a release named `ci-state`:
+  --title "CI state" --notes "Production database + manifest for slim CI"
+# Profile used by the CI workflow (DBT_PROFILES_DIR=ci). It holds no secret:
+# with DuckDB the "warehouse" is a file downloaded by the workflow.
+# One schema per pull request, like the dbt platform does for CI jobs.
+        description: True when the visitor left after a single event.
+    count(*) = 1                                      as is_bounce,   -- left after one event
+    description: Production run. Everything except unit tests (they need no production data).
+    description: Slim CI. Only the nodes modified in this branch and everything downstream.
